'''Matlo''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] worker who operated out of the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|Warren]], an Imperial Research Facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Matlo was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
